findings.text: all four cases plant a live pointer and a location that exists, so _mark_pointer's FileNotFoundError arm (reckon/crew/promotion_requests.py:371) and the OSError arm of _location_commits (:876) are never exercised; reverting either leaves the suite green, yet the 54 missing-file failures the plan measured are that path.

_failure_text and _raising_site (:896) re-implement the capability owned by reckon/crew/admission/attempts.py:36 _failure_with_origin -- naming a failure by its innermost raising frame -- instead of extending that owner to emit the module-qualified site the done_when asks for, so the repository now renders a stored failure's origin in two places.

_mark_pointer's catch was widened from PointerLockHeldError to every CrewError, a category the new comment does not name: a torn or unreadable pointer now leaves the request recorded with no pointer status instead of surfacing the refusal it used to raise.

_outcome_already_recorded is called from inside the except handler and calls _read, which raises on a torn receipt (json.JSONDecodeError) or a non-object receipt (CrewError); that escapes _run's thread and leaves the request RUNNING with no outcome recorded, so the fault handler can itself fault.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_promoted_run_settles_as_promoted.py:154 reddens if _outcome_already_recorded is removed and :186 reddens if _raising_site returns another frame, but :128 leaves the vanished-pointer and missing-file arms of promotion_requests.py:371 and :876 unexercised.
justifications.evidence: the after-arm log (after_suite-1795120706196347451.log:7 '62 passed') and base-arm log (baseline_suite-1795120631203428251.log:7 '58 passed') record the measure, but nothing in the gate runs the ruff format --check the done_when requires and no partition is named in the log.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/promotion_requests.py:839-912 follows the module's private-helper and docstring idiom, though the leading `result: ... = None` at :1183 is never read and the name _failure_text already means a different renderer in reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:73.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion_requests.py:839 reads the commit list from run_store.stored_run_rows by run id and :876 answers an undecodable or missing location as no commit, which is the settlement the goal names.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/promotion_requests.py:909 duplicates reckon/crew/admission/attempts.py:36 _failure_with_origin, while _stored_commits (:839) correctly extends run_store.stored_run_rows rather than reading the store itself.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 28fbf2bc..c82bf600 changes only reckon/crew/promotion_requests.py and tests/test_a_promoted_run_settles_as_promoted.py, both declared write paths, and carries nothing the goal does not imply.

verdicts.diff: VERDICT diff: read both commits against 28fbf2bc; f8294e366b rewrites the promoted-commit lookup (declared, stored by identity, tolerant location read), tolerates a vanished pointer and preserves a durable outcome, and c82bf60013 adds _location_commits as the last fallback (+24 -1) after the first commit regressed an existing receipt test.
verdicts.done_when: VERDICT done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_promoted_run_settles_as_promoted.py with four cases, a negative control, an all_debug run and a ruff format check; the file carries the four cases at lines 134, 143, 154 and 186, the after arm records 62 passed EXIT=0 and the negative control 3 failed EXIT=1, but no ruff format run and no partition are recorded.
verdicts.goal: VERDICT goal: the goal is that a promotion request whose run was promoted settles as promoted with no error; reckon/crew/promotion_requests.py:839 _stored_commits reads commits by run identity from the store and :863 _location_commits answers a non-document location as no commit, so the close no longer decodes the store as JSON.
